tasks.title: Define browser verification contracts
tasks.description: Create three new Contract pairs (md + JSON schema) that form the interface boundary for all browser verification components. First: check-spec contract — defines the shape of a Check Spec with fields for role, viewports, ordered steps (goto/click/fill/waitFor/capture/expect), masks for dynamic regions, and expected_visual_change. Second: visual-verdict contract — defines the verdict shape with verdict enum (expected/regression/unexpected/uncertain), rationale, viewport, panel votes, and capture reference. Third: bump the existing browser-check-result contract (resources/browser-check-result.md) to v2 in place, adding a version marker and a paired JSON schema at contracts/browser-check-result-schema.json. No separate -v2 file, since no v1 data needs to keep validating. v2 — captures Baseline/Candidate PNG paths, diff ratio, diff heatmap path, per-step results (description/passed/detail), console errors, and artifacts_dir. All three live in contracts/ as .md + .json schema pairs following the pattern in contracts/seed-contract.md. Never fabricate content beyond what the decisions specify.

tasks.title: Implement browser-auth.py script
tasks.description: Create scripts/browser-auth.py with a single subcommand: ensure --repo <Org/Repo> --role <role-name>. The script: (1) reads the Auth Profile from repo-policy.json for the given repo; (2) runs a Freshness probe — loads existing state from ~/.cache/claude-browser-auth/<repo-label>/<role>.json, launches a headless Chromium page, navigates to a known protected URL from the profile, and checks for a login redirect; if stale or missing, proceeds to regen; (3) regen via project-owned setup: for Quaestor-Web roles, POST to the bypass endpoints in order (/user/setup-test-users-and-entities/ then /user/authenticate-test-firm-user/ or company variant) against http://127.0.0.1:8000, then capture cookies via Playwright storageState; for SpawnedSapien roles, for active and admin run the project's playwright setup projects (npx playwright test --project=setup writes playwright/.auth/user.json; --project=admin-setup writes playwright/.auth/admin.json) and copy the result; for trial, journeyman, craftsman, inactive use api_login (Supabase signInWithPassword with E2E_<ROLE>_* creds from .env.local, then persist the session to localStorage via Playwright storageState); (4) copy the resulting storage state to ~/.cache/claude-browser-auth/<repo-label>/<role>.json (chmod 600), parent dirs created if absent; (5) run any seed_hooks declared in the Auth Profile via HTTP POST to the base URL; (6) print the absolute path to the state file on stdout. On any unrecoverable failure: print SKIPPED: auth_expired to stderr and exit 1. Script requires Python 3, playwright[chromium], and requests as dependencies.

tasks.title: Implement browser runner scripts
tasks.description: Create three scripts. First: scripts/browser-verify.mjs — accepts --spec <check-spec-json> --base-url <url> --state <storage-state-path-or-null> --out <output-dir>. For each viewport in the spec: launches Playwright Chromium headless; applies determinism setup (disable CSS animations via page.addStyleTag, freeze Date via page.addInitScript, wait for networkidle, wait for fonts); loads storageState if provided; executes each step in order (goto, click, fill, waitFor, capture takes a full-page PNG to <out>/<name>-<viewport>.png, expect runs a locator assertion); captures console.error and unhandled rejections; writes a manifest JSON to <out>/result.json. For capture pairs: runs pixelmatch on <baseline-png> vs <candidate-png>, writes <out>/<name>-<viewport>-diff.png heatmap and records diffRatio. Manifest shape matches browser-check-result-v2 contract. Second: scripts/base-server.sh up|down — up accepts --repo <path> --base-sha <sha> --port <offset-port>; creates a read-only git worktree at /tmp/base-worktree-<sha> for that SHA; symlinks each path listed in the repo's worktree_links from the main checkout; runs the project's start command (resolved via app-launch-detection); polls /health or / until HTTP 200 (max 60s); prints the URL. down tears down the worktree. Third: scripts/baseline-cache.py get|put — key is (spec-hash, base-sha, viewport, role-name); cache dir is ~/.cache/claude-browser-verify/; get prints the cached PNG paths or exits 1 on miss; put copies PNG files from a run dir into the cache keyed entry.

tasks.title: Build Verification Report artifact template
tasks.description: Create resources/verification-report-template.html — a private claude.ai artifact template that build-code publishes at run start. Load the artifact-capabilities skill before writing the page and use its documented db capability API (do not guess method names). The page uses that db capability to store capture results keyed by run ID. Layout: run metadata at top (repo, branch, PR link when known, N expected / N needs_eyes summary), then a section per Check Spec grouping captures by spec. Each capture row shows: spec name, route, viewport badge, Baseline PNG, Candidate PNG, Visual diff heatmap side-by-side, verdict badge (color-coded), judge rationale collapsed under a details element. needs_eyes items sort to the top of their spec group. Per-capture action buttons: Dismiss (removes from needs_eyes list) and Reject with an inline note textarea. Rejected items are written back to the artifact DB with status rejected and the note text. The page polls the DB for new captures while the run is in progress (streaming fill). Both dark and light mode supported via CSS custom properties. Page title: Verification Report. Icon: chart.

tasks.title: Implement visual-judge agent and register
tasks.description: Create agents/visual-judge.md — a Sonnet-tier agent that takes a capture pair (Baseline PNG path, Candidate PNG path, diff heatmap path, intent string from expected_visual_change, viewport name) and returns a visual-verdict JSON object. The agent: reads all three images with vision; applies the delta-only rubric (flaws already present in the Baseline are not findings; judges only what changed between the two); returns one of four verdicts: expected (the change matches intent and nothing else moved), regression (unintended change — broken layout, missing element, overflow, wrong state), unexpected (extra change beyond intent, not obviously broken), uncertain (cannot tell). For screener mode (single call): the caller checks if the verdict is expected; if not, spawns three panel instances. For panel mode: the agent is one of three; the caller aggregates 2-of-3. Mobile-viewport regression is always advisory in the intent field — the agent does not downgrade it; the caller (build-runner) does. Include frontmatter: name: visual-judge, model: claude-sonnet-5-5, description one-liner, tools: [Read]. Register in agents/registry.json with consumers: [build-runner]. Add to resources/model-tiers.json agents map as T2 (sonnet/medium).

tasks.title: Wire build-runner Phase 1
tasks.description: Rewrite step 4 of skills/build-runner/SKILL.md (browser verification) to use the new components. Step 4 now: (1) Check if the task has a browser_verify Check Spec; if not, skip. (2) Spawn browser-checker (Haiku) with the Check Spec, the candidate worktree URL, the base server URL (passed down from build-code), the repo Org/Repo string, and the run_dir. Retry up to 3 times on failure; bail early if two consecutive failures are identical. (3) On behavior failure (expect step failed): task status becomes failed, error plus rationale fed into the retry loop as fix context. Same as current behavior but with v2 contract. (4) Visual verdict: if all diff ratios are 0 and expected_visual_change is none, auto-pass (no judge call). Otherwise spawn visual-judge screener once (Sonnet). If screener returns expected, done. If screener returns regression/unexpected/uncertain, spawn 3 visual-judge panel instances in parallel; 2-of-3 majority wins; tie goes to uncertain. (5) Desktop regression: task status failed, judge rationale fed into retry loop. (6) Mobile-viewport regression: downgraded to needs_eyes regardless of panel result. (7) unexpected or uncertain on any viewport: needs_eyes. (8) needs_eyes task stays needs_eyes (does not block or retry); build-code continues. Post results to the run's Verification Report artifact DB entry (capture pair paths, verdict, rationale, viewport).

tasks.title: Implement check-spec-deriver agent
tasks.description: Create agents/check-spec-deriver.md — an Opus-tier agent that derives a Check Spec from a code diff when no Planned check exists. The agent: (1) receives the git diff of a completed TDD task; (2) determines if the diff touches FE files (components, routes, styles, templates) or API serializer / response shapes; if neither, returns null (no check needed); (3) for FE-touching diffs: maps changed files to their rendered routes by reading the Vite router (SpawnedSapien: src/App.tsx or equivalent router file) or Next.js app/pages dirs (Quaestor-Web); caps at 3 routes per shared component and records the rest as unchecked_consumers (array of file paths); (4) for serializer/response-shape diffs: identifies the API endpoint that changed and the frontend component that consumes it, derives the route that renders that component; (5) builds a minimal Check Spec for each derived route: goto the route, one capture at page-ready state, expected_visual_change: unknown, masks for common dynamic regions (timestamps, prices, user-generated content), role from the first Role in the repo's Auth Profile; (6) returns an array of Check Specs (one per derived route). Register in agents/registry.json with consumers: [build-runner]. Add to resources/model-tiers.json agents map as T4 (opus/xhigh).

tasks.title: Implement browser-explorer agent
tasks.description: Create agents/browser-explorer.md — a Sonnet-tier agent that performs a bounded Exploratory pass using the chrome-devtools MCP. Triggered when a Check Spec step fails or a Visual verdict is uncertain. The agent: receives the failed step description or uncertain capture pair paths, the route URL on the candidate server, and a brief diagnosis prompt; opens the URL in chrome-devtools MCP; inspects the DOM, console, and network tab; takes a targeted screenshot of the failing area; returns a plain-text diagnosis (no verdict, no pass/fail, only explanation of what it observed). The agent must not modify any app state and must not navigate away from the diagnosed route without documenting it. Diagnosis is appended to the build-runner retry-loop context and to the Verification Report capture entry. Register in agents/registry.json with consumers: [build-runner]. Add to resources/model-tiers.json agents map as T2 (sonnet/medium).

tasks.title: Scripted form login and human-seeded SSO auth strategies
tasks.description: Scripted form login and human-seeded SSO session auth strategies for browser-auth.py. Deferred until an app needs them. Both current apps (Quaestor-Web and SpawnedSapien) already bypass SSO via project-owned setup; form login and SSO are not needed today. Form login: reads selectors and credentials from macOS Keychain (security find-generic-password -w), fills login form with Playwright, captures storageState. Human-seeded: for real SSO (Google, Okta, MFA) that cannot be automated; opens a headed Playwright window once with playwright open --save-storage; prompts user via macOS notification on expiry; result stored in ~/.cache/claude-browser-auth/<repo>/<role>.json. Both strategies slot into browser-auth.py strategy chain after project-owned setup (strategy 0) and API login (strategy 1) per ADR-0005.
